args.prompt: Two slides on 'low' and 'max'. A street DJ table with a giant hand-painted effort fader labeled 'LOW' at one end and 'MAX' at the other; FAST slides it to LOW, SLOW slides it to MAX, both grinning at each other. Camera: Close on the fader, both hands in frame. 1990s hand-painted cel anime, warm golden sunrise light, film grain. Keep the art style, characters, faces, hair, outfits and any lettering exactly as in the first frame. Characters do not speak or sing; mouths stay closed or relaxed. No new text or subtitles.
args.negative_prompt: 3D render, CGI, photorealistic, morphing, warped faces, extra limbs, extra people, subtitles, captions, watermark, text changes
